sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: The Canary strawberry tree is an evergreen tree endemic to the Canary Islands. Flora accounts describe a medium-sized tree, often around 5–10 m; mature height varies by site. It bears leathery leaves, clusters of pale flowers and rounded red-orange fruits.

sections.title: Fruit and image
sections.text: The berry-like fruits are reported edible when ripe, with mild, somewhat mealy flesh. The plate's fruit and evergreen foliage are consistent with the species, but fruit colour changes as it ripens.
